vulnerability.name: USN-8568-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that some AMD Zen 2 processors did not properly isolate shared resources in the operation cache. A local attacker could possibly use this issue to corrupt instructions executed at a higher privilege level, resulting in privilege escalation. (CVE-2025-54518)  Several security issues were discovered in the Linux kernel. An attacker could possibly use these to compromise the system. This update corrects flaws in the following subsystems:   - PSP security protocol;   - ARM64 architecture;   - PowerPC architecture;   - RISC-V architecture;   - S390 architecture;   - User-Mode Linux
